title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第四十章、死罪

    大殿上，楚珠说出了事情的全部经过。她打晕八王爷，留下珠花，用血衣引包拯来查案，都是为了给李妃娘娘找回公道。
    “包大人，对不起，是我把事情弄复杂了。”楚珠说。
    “不，把事情弄复杂的人是我。如果我没有拒绝你，就不会有这些事了，蓝香也不会死，都是我的错。”八王爷说道：“包拯，所有的事情都因我而起，我一人承担，你定我一个人的罪就可以了。”
    “哈哈……”太后大笑起来，她抬手指向八王爷：“你是王爷，居然向一个宫女道歉！你确实有罪，你是先皇的亲弟弟，先皇让你的儿子做太子的时候，是多么信任你啊！但是你却没有说实话，那其实不是你的儿子啊！皇位传给了一个从外面捡回来的野孩子！这是多大的罪啊！包拯，都说你公正无私，那你说，这是什么罪？”
    包拯回答：“这是死罪。”
    “哈哈哈……”太后再转向皇帝：“我的好儿子，你要定八王爷死罪吗？还是你也认为八王爷和这个宫女在胡说呢？”
    “有什么区别吗？”皇帝问，他已经从震惊中回过神来了。
    “当然有区别！如果你接受他们的说法，那你就是外面捡回来的野孩子，不但八王爷要死，你也没有资格坐在这龙椅上。如果你认为他们是在胡说，那就让八王爷安静地回王府去，我可以保证一切事情都没有发生过，你还可以好好做你的皇帝！”
    皇帝把目光从八王爷身上收回来，他看向太后，问道：“他们说的那些事情，是您做的吗？您真的做过那些事吗？”他的眼里满是泪水，神情悲伤极了。太后一愣，没有回答，她沉默着，这时候的沉默其实也是一种回答，皇帝怎么会不明白？
    皇帝再艰难问道：“我叫了您四年母亲，是从心里把您当成母亲的，您呢？您把我当儿子了吗？”
    太后轻轻地笑了笑，那笑里有着一丝不易发现的悲伤：“我的亲生儿子四年前死了，你是我的第二个儿子。这四年里的每一天，我都因为有你而感到高兴。”
    皇帝沉默了一会儿，他把眼泪收了回去，问道：“包拯，八王爷是死罪，那太后呢？”
    包拯回答：“狸猫换太子，杀人，放火，条条都是死罪。”
    “包拯！我是太后，先皇的皇后！你敢！”太后怒道。
    “在我这里没有太后和皇后，只有作恶的犯人。”包拯道。
    “你！”太后气得说不出话来。
    皇帝站起来，大声道：“现在，包拯留下，其余人都退下。”
    太后看了皇帝一眼，转头走了。没有人再说话，每个人都安静地离开了。很快，大殿上只余皇帝和包拯了。
fullText.traditional:
第四十章、死罪

    大殿上，楚珠說出了事情的全部經過。她打暈八王爺，留下珠花，用血衣引包拯來查案，都是為了給李妃娘娘找回公道。
    “包大人，對不起，是我把事情弄複雜了。”楚珠說。
    “不，把事情弄複雜的人是我。如果我沒有拒絕你，就不會有這些事了，藍香也不會死，都是我的錯。”八王爺說道：“包拯，所有的事情都因我而起，我一人承擔，你定我一個人的罪就可以了。”
    “哈哈……”太后大笑起來，她抬手指向八王爺：“你是王爺，居然向一個宮女道歉！你確實有罪，你是先皇的親弟弟，先皇讓你的兒子做太子的時候，是多麼信任你啊！但是你卻沒有說實話，那其實不是你的兒子啊！皇位傳給了一個從外面撿回來的野孩子！這是多大的罪啊！包拯，都說你公正無私，那你說，這是什麼罪？”
    包拯回答：“這是死罪。”
    “哈哈哈……”太后再轉向皇帝：“我的好兒子，你要定八王爺死罪嗎？還是你也認為八王爺和這個宮女在胡說呢？”
    “有什麼區別嗎？”皇帝問，他已經從震驚中回過神來了。
    “當然有區別！如果你接受他們的說法，那你就是外面撿回來的野孩子，不但八王爺要死，你也沒有資格坐在這龍椅上。如果你認為他們是在胡說，那就讓八王爺安靜地回王府去，我可以保證一切事情都沒有發生過，你還可以好好做你的皇帝！”
    皇帝把目光從八王爺身上收回來，他看向太后，問道：“他們說的那些事情，是您做的嗎？您真的做過那些事嗎？”他的眼裡滿是淚水，神情悲傷極了。太后一愣，沒有回答，她沉默著，這時候的沉默其實也是一種回答，皇帝怎麼會不明白？
    皇帝再艱難問道：“我叫了您四年母親，是從心裡把您當成母親的，您呢？您把我當兒子了嗎？”
    太后輕輕地笑了笑，那笑裡有著一絲不易發現的悲傷：“我的親生兒子四年前死了，你是我的第二個兒子。這四年裡的每一天，我都因為有你而感到高興。”
    皇帝沉默了一會兒，他把眼淚收了回去，問道：“包拯，八王爺是死罪，那太后呢？”
    包拯回答：“狸貓換太子，殺人，放火，條條都是死罪。”
    “包拯！我是太后，先皇的皇后！你敢！”太后怒道。
    “在我這裡沒有太后和皇后，只有作惡的犯人。”包拯道。
    “你！”太后氣得說不出話來。
    皇帝站起來，大聲道：“現在，包拯留下，其餘人都退下。”
    太后看了皇帝一眼，轉頭走了。沒有人再說話，每個人都安靜地離開了。很快，大殿上只餘皇帝和包拯了。

sentences.simplified: 包拯回答：“狸猫换太子，杀人，放火，条条都是死罪。”
sentences.traditional: 包拯回答：“狸貓換太子，殺人，放火，條條都是死罪。”
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng huí dá lí māo huàn tài zǐ shā rén fàng huǒ tiáo tiáo dōu shì sǐ zuì
sentences.english: Bao Zheng replied, “Exchanging a leopard cat for a prince, murder, arson, each one is a capital offense.”

sentences.simplified: “包拯！我是太后，先皇的皇后！你敢！”太后怒道。
sentences.traditional: “包拯！我是太后，先皇的皇后！你敢！”太后怒道。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng wǒ shì tài hòu xiān huáng de huáng hòu nǐ gǎn tài hòu nù dào
sentences.english: “Bao Zheng! I am the empress dowager, the empress of the late emperor! How dare you!” the empress dowager said angrily.

sentences.simplified: “在我这里没有太后和皇后，只有作恶的犯人。”包拯道。
sentences.traditional: “在我這裡沒有太后和皇后，只有作惡的犯人。”包拯道。
sentences.pinyin: zài wǒ zhè lǐ méi yǒu tài hòu hé huáng hòu zhǐ yǒu zuò è de fàn rén bāo zhěng dào
sentences.english: “There is no empress dowager or empress here, only criminals who have committed evil deeds,” Bao Zheng said.

sentences.simplified: “你！”太后气得说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: “你！”太后氣得說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ tài hòu qì de shuō bù chū huà lái
sentences.english: “You!” the empress dowager was so furious that she couldn’t speak.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝站起来，大声道：“现在，包拯留下，其余人都退下。”
sentences.traditional: 皇帝站起來，大聲道：“現在，包拯留下，其餘人都退下。”
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì zhàn qǐ lái dà shēng dào xiàn zài bāo zhěng liú xià qí yú rén dōu tuì xià
sentences.english: The emperor stood up and said loudly, “Now, Bao Zheng will stay, and everyone else will leave.”

sentences.simplified: 太后看了皇帝一眼，转头走了。没有人再说话，每个人都安静地离开了。
sentences.traditional: 太后看了皇帝一眼，轉頭走了。沒有人再說話，每個人都安靜地離開了。
sentences.pinyin: tài hòu kàn le huáng dì yì yǎn zhuǎn tóu zǒu le méi yǒu rén zài shuō huà měi ge rén dōu ān jìng de lí kāi le
sentences.english: The empress dowager glanced at the emperor, then turned and left. No one said another word, and everyone left quietly.

sentences.simplified: 很快，大殿上只余皇帝和包拯了。
sentences.traditional: 很快，大殿上只餘皇帝和包拯了。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài dà diàn shang zhǐ yú huáng dì hé bāo zhěng le
sentences.english: Soon, only the emperor and Bao Zheng were left in the audience hall.

sentence_translations: Chapter 40: Capital Offense
In the audience hall, Chu Zhu recounted the entire course of events.
She knocked the Eighth Prince out, left behind a hairpin, and used a bloodstained garment to lure Bao Zheng into investigating the case, ..
.. all in order to seek justice for Consort Li.
“Lord Bao, I’m sorry, I made things complicated,” Chu Zhu said.
“No, I am the one who made things complicated.
If I hadn’t refused you, none of this would have happened, and Lan Xiang wouldn’t have died. It’s all my fault.”
The Eighth Prince said, “Bao Zheng, everything started because of me. I take full responsibility. You can punish only me.”
“Haha …” the empress dowager laughed heartily.
She raised her hand and pointed at the Eighth Prince: “You are a prince, and yet you apologized to a palace maid!
You are indeed guilty. You are the late emperor’s younger brother. How much he trusted you when he made your son the crown prince!
But you didn’t tell the truth. That child wasn’t actually your son!
The throne was passed on to a wild child picked up from outside! What a great crime this is!
Bao Zheng, everyone says you are fair and impartial, so tell me, what is this crime?”
Bao Zheng replied, “This is a capital offense.”
“Hahaha …” the empress dowager then turned to the emperor, “My good son, are you going to sentence the Eighth Prince to death?
Or do you also think that the Eighth Prince and this palace maid are talking nonsense?”
“Is there any difference?” the emperor asked. He had already recovered from the shock.
“Of course there’s a difference! If you accept their words, then you are just a wild child picked up from the outside.
Not only will the Eighth Prince have to die, you also have no right to sit on this imperial throne.
If you think they are talking nonsense, then let the Eighth Prince return quietly to his mansion.
I can assure you that none of this had ever happened, and you can continue to be a good emperor!”
The emperor shifted his gaze away from the Eighth Prince.
He looked at the empress dowager and asked, “Those things they speak of, did you do them? Did you really do those things?”
His eyes were full of tears, and his expression was extremely sad.
The empress dowager was taken aback and did not respond.
She remained silent, but this silence in itself was an answer. How could the emperor not understand?
The emperor asked with difficulty, ..
.. “I have called you mother for four years, and I truly regard you as my mother in my heart. What about you? Do you consider me your son?”
The empress dowager smiled gently.
That smile had a hint of hidden sadness in it: “My biological son died four years ago. You are my second son.
Every single day of these four years, I have felt happy because of you.”
The emperor was silent for a moment.
He held back his tears and asked, “Bao Zheng, the Eighth Prince is guilty of a capital offense, but what about the empress dowager?”
Bao Zheng replied, “Exchanging a leopard cat for a prince, murder, arson, each one is a capital offense.”
“Bao Zheng! I am the empress dowager, the empress of the late emperor! How dare you!” the empress dowager said angrily.
“There is no empress dowager or empress here, only criminals who have committed evil deeds,” Bao Zheng said.
“You!” the empress dowager was so furious that she couldn’t speak.
The emperor stood up and said loudly, “Now, Bao Zheng will stay, and everyone else will leave.”
The empress dowager glanced at the emperor, then turned and left. No one said another word, and everyone left quietly.
Soon, only the emperor and Bao Zheng were left in the audience hall.
